# The link.clicked event and its payload

> [`LinkClicked`](link-click-analytics.md) is the versioned `link.clicked` event that describes one click on a share link, with a unique click id, the link code, a timestamp and a few optional details.

_Part of [Link click attribution and stats](link-click-analytics.md)_

[`LinkClicked`](link-click-analytics.md) is declared at the top of `share-link.service.ts` with `defineEvent('link.clicked', 'links', 1, ...)`. It has a name, a group (`links`), a version number (1) and a `zod` schema. That schema is the shape of every click message. A click happens when someone follows a short link. `recordClick` builds the event with `LinkClicked.create`. It makes a time-ordered click id with [`uuidv7`](../../../../packages/backend/scripts/load-tests/lib/utils.js#L14), stamps the current time as an ISO string, and fills in country, referer and the edge flag. The referer is cut to 300 characters. Anything missing becomes an empty string, or `false` for the edge flag. Then `recordClick` sends the event to the topic from `LinkClicked.topic`. It uses the link code as the Kafka key, so all clicks for one link stay together. It does not wait for the send and ignores errors, so the redirect is never slowed. The rest of the pipeline is in [Link click attribution and stats](link-click-analytics.md).

**Look at:** [`LinkClicked` in share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts#L17) · [share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts)

## Pieces

- [Click event payload shape and defaults](click-event-schema.md): A `zod` object with click id, link code and timestamp as required strings, plus country, referer and the via-edge flag, which default to empty or false.
- [Building and sending the click event](fire-and-forget-click-recording.md): `recordClick` fills the payload (new [`uuidv7`](../../../../packages/backend/scripts/load-tests/lib/utils.js#L14) click id, current time, trimmed referer) and sends it to Kafka keyed by the link code without awaiting.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| event | `link.clicked (version 1, group links)` | Created by `recordClick` for every counted click and sent through [`KafkaProducerService`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/infrastructure/kafka/kafka-producer.service.ts#L7). |
| queue | `LinkClicked.topic (Kafka)` | The event is sent here with the link code as the message key. |

## Watch out

- The Kafka key is the link code, not the click id. All clicks for one link go to the same partition, so a very popular link can make a hot partition.
- The `ts` field is a plain string, not a date type, so the schema does not check that it is a valid time.
- Defaults only apply when a field is missing. The `viaEdge` flag is `false` unless the caller passes `true`, and `recordClick` always fills all fields anyway.
- The schema version is the third argument to [`defineEvent`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/infrastructure/events/define-event.ts#L24) (`1`). Changing the payload shape would mean bumping it.
